pickupText: Slightly increase attack speed and movement speed.
description: Increases attack speed by 7.5% (+7.5% per stack) and movement speed by 7% (+7% per stack).

name: Oddly-shaped Opal
pickupText: Reduce damage the first time you are hit.
description: Increase armor by 100 (+100 per stack) while out of danger.

name: Elusive Antlers
pickupText: Spawns orbs of energy that give bonus movement speed.
description: Spawns orbs of energy nearby every 10s (-10% per stack), giving +12% movement speed up to 3 (+3 per stack) times for 12s.

stacking.formula: maxStacks = 3 + 3(n-1) (CharacterBody.GetElusiveAntlersCurrentMaxStack). Linear: 3, 6, 9 orbs.
+12% move speed per ORB held, flat regardless of item count (CharacterBody.RecalculateStats: num98 += 0.12f x buffCount). Each orb buff lasts 7s.

interval = 10 - (1 - 3/(n+2)) x 8 seconds (ElusiveAntlersBehavior.FixedUpdate). Hyperbolic, approaching but never reaching 2s: 1 stack = 10s, 2 stacks = 8s, 3 stacks = 6.8s, 4 stacks = 6s, 5 stacks = 5.43s, 10 stacks = 4s. The previously recorded "-10% per stack, multiplicative" would give 9s at 2 stacks; the real value is 8s.
barrier = 10 + 7(n-1) per orb (ElusiveAntlersPickup prefab: baseBarrierAmount 10, additionalBarrierAmountPerAdditionalItemStack 7). Absent from the in-game description entirely.

name: Chronic Expansion
pickupText: Deal bonus damage for each enemy killed.
description: Killing an enemy increases your damage by 3.5% (+1% per stack), up to 10 (+5 per stack), for 7s. Dealing damage refreshes the timer.

name: Warped Echo
pickupText: Incoming damage is reduced and dealt over time.
description: The next source of damage is reduced by 10% and spread into 3 (+1 per stack) hits. All echoed damage is non-lethal except for the final hit. Recharges every 15s.

name: Item Scrap, White
pickupText: Does nothing. Prioritized when used with 3D Printers.
description: A Common-rarity scrap with no effect. Consumed first by 3D Printers and Cauldrons, letting you preserve real items.

name: Rusted Key
pickupText: Gain access to a Rusty Lockbox that contains a powerful item.
description: A hidden cache containing an item (80% Uncommon / 20% Legendary) will appear in a random location on each stage.

stacking.formula: One lockbox per stage per key-holder; additional keys' effect on rarity vs. count needs logbook confirmation

unlock.requirement: Defeat the Teleporter boss under 15 seconds.

name: Hiker's Boots
pickupText: Striking enemies from a higher elevation grants critical strike chance and damage.
description: Striking enemies from a higher elevation grants +1% (+1% per stack) critical strike chance and critical strike damage, up to 10 times. Lasts 10 seconds.

stacking.stat: Crit chance & crit damage per elevated hit (%)
stacking.cap: Buff caps at 10 x item count (GlobalEventManager: num = 10 * itemCountEffective), NOT a flat 10. So the ceiling rises with stacks: +10% at 1 stack, +20% at 2, +30% at 3.
stacking.formula: Each elevated hit grants n buff stacks (n = item count); the buff caps at 10n. Each stack is +1% crit chance AND +1% crit damage (CharacterBody: num111 += buffCount; critMultiplier += 0.01f * buffCount). Lasts 10s, refreshed on hit.

name: 57 Leaf Clover
pickupText: Luck is on your side.
description: All random effects are rolled +1 (+1 per stack) times for a favorable outcome.

stacking.formula: +1 luck per stack (CharacterBody.RecalculateStats: luck += Clover count). Luck L = (57 Leaf Clover stacks - Purity stacks). Util.CheckRoll rolls 1 + ceil(|L|) times and keeps the BEST result when L > 0, the WORST when L < 0. Effective chance = 1 - (1-p)^(1+L) for positive luck: a 10% proc becomes 19.0% at L=1 and 27.1% at L=2.

pickupText: Chance to hook all nearby enemies.
description: 20% (+20% per stack) chance on hit to fire homing hooks at up to 10 (+5 per stack) enemies for 100% TOTAL damage.

stacking.formula: chance = (1 - 100/(100 + 20n)) x 100 (GlobalEventManager). Hyperbolic: 16.7% at 1 stack, 28.6% at 2, 37.5% at 3 - approaches but never reaches 100%.
maxTargets = 5 + 5n (GlobalEventManager). Linear: 10 enemies at 1 stack, 15 at 2, 20 at 3.

stacking.formula: duration /= n (HeadstompersCooldown.OnEnter, baseDuration 10s). Reciprocal: 10s, 5s, 3.3s, 2.5s.

cooldown x= 0.75 per stack, applied in a per-stack loop (DroneWeaponsBoostBehavior.cooldownReductionPerStack = 0.75). Exponential: x0.75, x0.5625, x0.4219.

name: Purity
pickupText: Reduce your skill cooldowns by 2 seconds. You are unlucky.
description: All skill cooldowns are reduced by 2 (+1 per stack) seconds. All random effects are rolled +1 (+1 per stack) times for an unfavorable outcome.

stacking.formula: cooldown reduction = 2 + 1(n-1) seconds (CharacterBody.RecalculateStats). Linear.

-1 luck per stack (CharacterBody.RecalculateStats: luck -= Purity count). Luck L = (57 Leaf Clover stacks - Purity stacks). Util.CheckRoll rolls 1 + ceil(|L|) times and keeps the BEST result when L > 0, the WORST when L < 0. Effective chance = 1 - (1-p)^(1+L) for positive luck: a 10% proc becomes 19.0% at L=1 and 27.1% at L=2. With negative luck the worst roll is kept, so a 10% proc drops to ~1.0% at L=-1.

unlock.requirement: Escape the moon on Monsoon difficulty.

stacking.formula: chargeRate x= 1 + 0.3n (HoldoutZoneController.FocusConvergenceController). Linear +30% per stack.
stacking.cap: Hard cap at 3 stacks (cap = 3): a 4th and beyond do nothing at all.

stacking.formula: radius /= 2n (convergenceRadiusDivisor = 2). Reciprocal: zone is 1/2 size at 1 stack, 1/4 at 2, 1/6 at 3 - i.e. 50%, 75%, 83.3% smaller.

name: Stone Flux Pauldron
pickupText: Double your health... BUT halve your speed.
description: Increase max health by 100% (+100% per stack). Reduce movement speed by 50% (+50% per stack).

stacking.formula: maxHealth multiplier += 1.0 x n (CharacterBody.RecalculateStats). Linear: +100% per stack, matching the description.

moveSpeed x= 1/(1 + 2n) — the count is added to the speed divisor TWICE in RecalculateStats, confirmed at IL level (two separate `ldloc 46; add` into the divisor local; the local is stored only twice, a zero-init and the item count, so it is not a reused slot). Code-verified reduction: 66.7% at 1 stack, 80% at 2, 85.7% at 3. The in-game description says 50% (+50% per stack), which does not match the code.

name: Light Flux Pauldron
pickupText: Halve your cooldowns... BUT halve your attack speed.
description: Decrease skill cooldowns by 50% (+50% per stack). Decrease attack speed by 50% (+50% per stack).

stacking.formula: cooldown x= 0.5 per stack, applied in a per-stack loop (CharacterBody.RecalculateStats). Exponential: 50%, 75%, 87.5% reduction.

attackSpeed /= (n + 1) (CharacterBody.RecalculateStats, applied ONCE - contrast Stone Flux Pauldron, which adds to its divisor twice). Reciprocal: 50% at 1, 66.7% at 2, 75% at 3, 80% at 4 - approaches but never reaches a full stop.

name: Longstanding Solitude
pickupText: Free purchases on level up... BUT gold converts to experience.
description: On level up, gain a free unlock for the next purchase (+1 per stack), but all gold is converted to experience. Anything that costs gold costs 50% (+50% per stack) more.

stacking.cap: Hard cap at 3 (CharacterBody.AddFreeChestBuff: the grant loop runs while i < 3). A 4th stack grants NO extra free unlock, despite the description reading +1 per stack.
stacking.formula: 1 free unlock per stack, capped at 3 per level up (AddFreeChestBuff). Separately, the gold->XP conversion factor is 0.12 + 0.0125(n-1) with the stack count clamped to 8 (CharacterMaster.GiveMoneyWithOnLevelUpFreeUnlock).

max bombs = 2 + n (LunarSunBehavior: return 2 + itemCount). Linear: 3 at 1 stack, 4 at 2, 5 at 3.

pickupText: Ignite everything nearby... including you and allies.
description: Ignite ALL characters within 15m for 12s, dealing 5% of your maximum health per second as burning damage. The burn is 0.5x on yourself, 0.25x on allies, and 24x on enemies. Cooldown: 45s.

unlock.requirement: Kill 15 enemies simultaneously.

name: Spinel Tonic
pickupText: Gain a massive boost to ALL stats. Chance to gain an affliction that reduces ALL stats.
description: Gain a 20-second buff: +100% damage, +70% attack speed, +20 armor, +50% max health, +300% regen, +30% movement speed. On expiration, a 20% chance to gain a Tonic Affliction reducing all stats by -5% per stack. Cooldown: 60s.

unlock.requirement: Discover and enter three unique portals.

name: Ifrit's Distinction
pickupText: Become an aspect of fire.
description: Gain Blazing Elite powers: your attacks apply a burn for 50% TOTAL damage on hit, and a fire trail follows burned enemies. Passive (no cooldown).

name: Silence Between Two Strikes
pickupText: Become an aspect of lightning.
description: Gain the power of an Overloading Elite: your attacks explode after a delay, and 50% of your health is replaced by shield. Passive (no cooldown).

name: Her Biting Embrace
pickupText: Become an aspect of ice.
description: Gain the power of a Glacial Elite: leave an ice explosion on death and apply an 80% slow on hit. Passive (no cooldown).

name: Spectral Circlet
pickupText: Become an aspect of incorporeality.
description: Gain the power of a Celestine Elite: your attacks apply an 80% slow on hit, and nearby allies gain invisibility. Passive (no cooldown).

name: His Spiteful Boon
pickupText: Become an aspect of spite.
description: Gain the power of a Twisted Elite: tether to up to 5 allies within 35m, granting them 300 armor. If tethered allies are hit 10 times, fire a lunar spike ball that homes onto an enemy for 100% damage and inflicts Lunar Ruin twice. Tethering disables for 10s after launching. Passive.

name: N'kuhana's Retort
pickupText: Become an aspect of corruption.
description: Gain the power of a Malachite Elite: inflict a healing-disabled debuff for 8s on enemies, periodically release spiked balls that explode and leave spike pits, and spawn a Malachite Urchin on death. Passive.

name: His Reassurance
pickupText: Become an aspect of earth.
description: Gain the power of a Mending Elite: continuously heal nearby allies, and spawn a Healing Core on death that detonates to heal all nearby allies. Passive.

name: Shared Design
pickupText: Become an aspect of perfection.
description: Gain the power of a Perfected Elite: attacks inflict Cripple, fire 4 bombs every 10 seconds (30% damage each), gain +30% movement speed, and +25% max health converted to shields. Passive.

name: Of One Mind
pickupText: Become an aspect of the Collective.
description: Gain the power of a Collective Elite: a 30m dome blocks projectiles and reduces ally and self skill cooldowns by 20%. On death, explode for 100% damage and disable enemy items for 2.5s. The dome disables for 8s when hit by a skill attack. Passive.

name: Aurelionite's Blessing
pickupText: Become an aspect of radiance.
description: Gain the power of a Gilded Elite: on hit, knock 8 gold out of enemies as collectible nuggets (scaling over time), and gain a rechargeable grounded spike attack for 15% (outer) / 150% (inner) damage. Cooldown: 25s.
